sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया । विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
hindiTranslation: यह गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतर शरणागतिरूप ज्ञान मैंने तुझे कह दिया ।  अब तू इसपर अच्छी तरहसे विचार करके जैसा चाहता है, वैसा कर ॥
englishTranslation: Thus I have explained to you the most secret wisdom. Reflect on it fully, and then do as you wish.
essence: True guidance ends by returning choice to you.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Krishna says he has given Arjuna the deepest teaching. Arjuna should think it through completely and then decide what to do.
simpleInsight: Real freedom includes thinking clearly before choosing.
detailedMeaning: Arjuna has heard Krishna’s final teaching about surrender and inner freedom. Krishna gives the instruction without forcing obedience, then leaves Arjuna responsible for his own choice.
modernRelevance: A father lays out everything he knows about the two marriage proposals, then tells his daughter the decision is hers. Krishna does the same with Arjuna: the full teaching first, then the freedom to choose after reflection.
translationLiteral: इति (thus) / ते (to you) / ज्ञानम् (wisdom) / आख्यातम् (has been explained) / गुह्यात् (than the secret) / गुह्यतरम् (more secret) / मया (by me) / विमृश्य (having reflected upon) / एतत् (this) / अशेषेण (completely) / यथा (as) / इच्छसि (you wish) / तथा (so) / कुरु (do)
insight: After the secret teaching, Krishna hands the choice back: reflect on it fully, then do as you wish.

quoteVariants.text: I have shown you the deepest secret. Reflect fully, then choose your course.
The decision is yours after full reflection.
